items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there was a Toots Camarata writing music for Jimmy Dorsey, I think.

ctx.x: Polls. Excuse me. Sometimes… Polls, you know. And we saw, and we knew all the guys who played with whom. There was a Toots Mondello with Benny Goodman, and there was a Toots Camarata writing music for Jimmy Dorsey, I think. And also some backgrounds for Billie Holiday. And a trumpet player, you know. He still lives. We’ll call you Toots. And I just said, [inaudible]. I didn’t say anything. But it’s kind of good. It’s a timeless kind of stamp on you, I guess. You can look old and be called Toots. [laughs] That’s…
So somebody suggested it, or you just said…
